## listTokens

List Tokens. `GET /channel-connect-tokens`

List channel connect tokens for this tenant.

By default, only shows active (non-expired, non-revoked) tokens. Use query parameters to include inactive tokens.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->listTokens();
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$includeExpired` | `?bool` | no | Include expired tokens |
| `$includeRevoked` | `?bool` | no | Include revoked tokens |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<ChannelConnectToken>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/list_tokens_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens_get)

## createToken

Create Token. `POST /channel-connect-tokens`

Create a new channel connect token.

Generates a secure, time-limited token that can be shared with partners or clients to allow them to connect messaging channels without full platform access.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->createToken(allowedChannelTypes: []);
```

- Scopes: `channels:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$allowedChannelTypes` | `list<string>` | yes | Channel types allowed to connect: telegram, whatsapp, instagram, messenger, gmail, smtp_imap, proxy, sendgrid_byok, mailgun_byok, sendgrid_managed, sms |
| `$name` | `?string` | no | User-friendly name for this token (e.g., 'Acme Corp Setup') |
| `$expiresInHours` | `?int` | no | Token validity in hours (1-168, default 24) |
| `$maxUses` | `?int` | no | Maximum number of successful connections (1-100, default 10) |
| `$useWindowMinutes` | `?int` | no | Grace period in minutes after first use (5-1440, default 30) |
| `$allowedChannelModes` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Optional per-channel connect-mode restrictions. Shape: {"instagram": ["messaging","social"], "messenger": ["business_messaging","business_social","personal_social"], "whatsapp": ["classic","coexistence"]}. An ABSENT channel key (or a null value) means ALL modes are allowed for that channel (backwards compatible). A channel key MUST list at least one mode — to allow every mode, omit the key rather than passing []. Enforcement is the intersection of these modes with the tenant's feature gating, fail-closed. |
| `$partnerName` | `?string` | no | Partner/client name to display on connect page |
| `$partnerRedirectUrl` | `?string` | no | URL to redirect to after successful connection |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ChannelConnectTokenCreated`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/create_token_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens_post)

## delegate

Delegate Connect. `POST /channel-connect-tokens/delegate`

Hand a channel connect over to a colleague by email.

Creates a short-lived connect token scoped to the given channel types and mails the link to email. Intended for the channel setup wizard, where the person doing the setup often lacks the third-party platform access the connect needs (typically: they are not an admin of the Meta Business portfolio that owns the WhatsApp number or the Facebook Page).

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->delegate(email: 'email', channelTypes: []);
```

- Scopes: `channels:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$email` | `string` | yes | Address of the colleague/agency who will do the connect |
| `$channelTypes` | `list<string>` | yes | Channel types the link may connect — normally a single platform. The consolidated email option expands to its provider sub-types. |
| `$recipientName` | `?string` | no | Recipient display name used in the email salutation |
| `$note` | `?string` | no | Optional message from the requester, shown in the email |
| `$expiresInHours` | `?int` | no | Link validity in hours (1-168, default 48) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ChannelConnectDelegate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/delegate_connect_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens_delegate_post)

## revokeToken

Revoke Token. `DELETE /channel-connect-tokens/{token_id}`

Revoke a channel connect token.

Revoking a token immediately prevents any further use. This action cannot be undone - create a new token if needed.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->revokeToken(tokenId: 'token_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$tokenId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$reason` | `?string` | no | Reason for revocation (for audit purposes) |

Returns `Delete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/revoke_token_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens__token_id__delete)
